claims.statement: Livia married the future Augustus in 38 BCE and became an important adviser. Her son Tiberius eventually succeeded him. She continued to exercise influence after Augustus’ death. Hostile stories about her role in the family’s deaths should not be treated as established fact.
Livia Drusilla: 58 BCE to 29 CE. Lifespan follows Store norske leksikon: 58 BCE–29 CE. Dates are at year resolution; there is no year zero. No continuous personal location is inferred.
